figures.title: Horsepasture temperature: original observations and sampling coverage
figures.caption: Original station 21NC03WQ-H6000000, 106 water-temperature records. Markers distinguish reported analytical methods; open markers carry an original coded qualification. The dashed 20°C reference is the trout-temperature criterion in NC's 2022 assessment methodology. The vertical lines bound 2016–2020. Dates retain the published calendar date; original times and timezone labels remain in thermal-screen.csv. The monthly panel shows observations by calendar month for each five-year window. The earlier window has no July readings; summer accounts for 7 of 31 records versus 12 of 26 later. Counts are descriptive and do not establish a temporal trend.

figures.title: Horsepasture total phosphorus: results and original reporting limits
figures.caption: Original total-phosphorus records, USEPA 365.1, reported as P. Filled circles are uncensored results; open circles retain coded qualifications. Open triangles locate each original practical quantitation limit for a non-detected result; their vertical position is the reporting limit, not an estimated concentration. Original media-subdivision labels change from blank to Surface Water in 2013 and remain separate in comparison-groups.csv. All 144 records, methods, comments and 88 non-detections remain traceable to original result and limit files.
